text: player
I arrive at the Mahjong Soul Shrine early on the day Chiori Mikami and I agreed to play mahjong together.
Riu Kujou
Was that Riu Kujou who just ran by quickly with a broom in her hands?
Ichihime

Riu got here a long time ago, nyaa. She said that Chiori can't come because she has too much homework to do and that a professional maid like her can't be late for an appointment that she is attending on behalf of Chiori, nyaa.
Oh, thanks for telling me that. Now I have another question for you.
...Why have your eyes lost their usual luster?
Ichihime and Wanjirou are hugging themselves tightly while hiding in a dark corner, and I probably wouldn't have noticed them if Ichihime hasn't said something to me just now.
Riu says she can't stand how dirty and messy it is here, nyaa...
Wanjirou
So she decided to personally clean and tidy the mahjong room before the shrine is open to the public today...
Dirty! Messy! Vile! I can almost see these giant hostile words crushing down on Ichihime and Wanjirou's spines.

Well, that's not very fair. Many people come to the Mahjong Soul Shrine every day because it's the largest shrine in One Han City. The environment is quite well maintained, and I think the mahjong room has always been very clean!
Really, nyaa? Is that what you really think, nyaa?
Have I ever lied to you before? I'm certain that Riu has exaggerated things.
I pat their heads to console them, then I walk righteously and nonchalantly into the mahjong room that Riu Kujou has reorganized.
Is this even the same room? It's so much cleaner than before!!!
Ahem, well, I guess I can only say that I thought it was clean until I saw what she did with the place.
Ichihime & Wanjirou
*sobs--*

Alas, given how incredible Riu Kujou's cleaning abilities are as a professional maid, it's probably better to let Ichihime and Wanjirou shut themselves off from the rest of the world in the corner for a little longer.
Sigh...
Wait a minute, Riu, why are you also sighing?
The shrine is opening soon, but I still haven't finished cleaning!
What are you saying? It already looks really clean.
Well, it's only clean here.
Hmm?

I was only going to clean one mahjong table, but cleaning it made the other tables look even messier, so I started to clean the other tables. After I cleaned all the tables, the floor, windows, ceiling... and even the corridor outside the mahjong room started to look dirty and messy to me...
So I cleaned the entire mahjong room, and now I want to clean everything!
I-I see...
Console her by telling her that she's already done a good job.
Agree with her idea to continue cleaning outside the mahjong room.
I understand the pain of being forced to stop cleaning before you're finished, so I support you if you want to do more cleaning.

But it's almost time for the shrine to open, and it'll be inconvenient for me to continue cleaning after people start coming in. Moreover, I'm here to play mahjong with you on behalf of Miss Chiori today.

We can play mahjong any day. Ichihime, Wanjirou... why don't we give mahjong a break for one day and clean the Mahjong Soul Shrine today instead? All our problems will be solved, and you guys can stop feeling depressed, right?
I get to clean the shrine with you, Master? I can do that, nyaa!
I second that, woof.
In that case, leave the Mahjong Soul Shrine to me! I'll do my best to clean this place!
I'll also put my life on the line, nyaa!
Hey, don't use idioms randomly!
That's how we started cleaning the Mahjong Soul Shrine.
Under Riu Kujou's leadership, the cleaning progressed faster than expected, and we completed a lot of work in just a few hours.
After several hours of cleaning
Riu is incredible, nyaa... She can do more work than ten of me combined, nyaa...
Although I've always known that Miss Kujou is amazing, she seems even more incredible than when I first met her, woof. She is already a professional cleaner and organizer.
Of course! I aspire to become the world's best maid, so it's a given that I need to keep learning various skills!
I'm getting motivated, nyaa! I've decided, nyaa!
Have you decided to keep learning more things like Riu?
I've decided to train you into the best master in the world, nyaa!
...I guess you know a thing or two about that, right?
Riu has been working really hard, nyaa, so you can take care of the pile of garbage that was just removed from the kitchen, storage room, reception room, mahjong room, and other places, nyaa!
Sometimes, I feel like I don't want to be your master... Wanjirou! Stop running away!
My waist injury hasn't recovered yet, woof. My friend, you'll definitely become the world's best friend, woof.
How can you run away so quickly if you haven't recovered yet? Shouldn't you try to pretend at least?!
Phew! That's the last bag! It's all done!
Outside the Mahjong Soul Shrine
After disposing of the bags of garbage of various sizes, I stretch my body, which has started to creak after all that hard work.

I can't believe I took care of everything in the end. As expected, Riu really is efficient. One morning is all she needs to clean up the living area of the shrine, and I also learned lots of storage and cleaning tips from her.

Speaking of which, Riu only graduated from high school last year, but she already has such an impressive presence when she tells people what to do. She reminds me of my homeroom teacher in high school...

She seems like someone who would suddenly peek inside a classroom's window to see if students are paying attention during class or who would walk quietly behind a student who is daydreaming and pat them on the shoulder while acting casual...
Hi.
AHHHH!

Someone suddenly pats me on the shoulder while I'm talking to myself. I turn around and see that the person who patted my shoulder is a gentle-looking middle-aged man who has sharp eyes. If I had to describe him, I would say he looks like a homeroom teacher.
I'm sorry for startling you.
Wh-Who are you?
Mr. Makiki
I'm Makiki, a teacher from St. Tina's Girls' School, and Riu Kujou was my student. Is she here at Mahjong Soul Shrine today?
Huh?
I'm back.
Mahjong Soul Shrine
What? You've thrown out all the trash already? You're fitter than I expected.
I've brought over some snacks, so go and have some first. I'll wipe these mahjong tiles again before I start cooking. Since you've done so well today, tell me what you want to eat, and I'll make it.
As Riu Kujou is completely focused on wiping mahjong tiles when I get back, she speaks to me without looking up, so she naturally doesn't notice that there's another person beside me.
Ahem, Riu, your teacher is here.
Hmm?
Riu Kujou finally raises her head after hearing this.
...Mr. Makiki?
Hmm, Kujou... Eh? Where are you going? Stop right there!
Riu Kujou drops the mahjong tiles in her hands and runs away swiftly, then Mr. Makiki starts running after her.
Seeing them run off into the distance, Ichihime comes up to me and asks me a question.
Master, what's going on, nyaa?
Well... to put it simply, that person is Riu's high school teacher. Riu didn't go to college after graduating from high school last year, so her teacher has come to persuade her to go to college.

I recall the conversation I just had with Mr. Makiki and summarize the situation for Ichihime. At this time, Riu Kujou and Mr. Makiki have run a full circle around the place and come back to us. After that, they start arguing while running around us.
Why have you come here to look for me? How did you know that I'm here?
Hmph! I'm your teacher after all. Did you think I wouldn't be able to find you if you stopped taking my calls?
I already told you that I won't go to college! Stop trying to persuade me!
Riu Kujou, you placed among the top ten in the college entrance examination last year! Don't you think it's unreasonable for you to not apply for college?
It's not like you have to go to college if you have good grades. I have something more important to do!
Do you think cleaning and cooking are more important than going to college? Don't you think that doing such simple things is a waste of your talent?
Mr. Makiki is devastated, and his tone conveys his disappointment in her for failing to meet his expectations.
These tasks are part of a great maid's work! They aren't simple at all! No matter what you think, I'm definitely not going to college.
Geez, child... stop running. I'm not here to argue with you today. Since we don't see eye to eye on this matter, why don't we decide it with a contest?
Riu Kujou stops running after hearing his words.
...What contest?

We'll compete in the work skills you just mentioned. Didn't you just say that they aren't simple at all? I want to see what makes them special. If you lose to me, you'll retake the college examinations.
Okay, I accept your challenge. If you lose, you'll stop bugging me about going to college.
It's a deal.
A contest? Woohoo! In that case, Ichihime, Master, and Wanjirou will be your judges, nyaa. Don't worry, we'll definitely be ruthless!
I already told you to stop misusing words like this!
That's how the cleaning of the Mahjong Soul Shrine became a contest in the chaos.
The first professional maid skills contest of Mahjong Soul Shrine has officially started! Let's invite the contestants into the venue now.
Ichihime plays some exciting music in the background while Riu Kujou and Mr. Makiki walk into the contest venue, the courtyard of the Mahjong Soul Shrine, with their heads held high.
Mr. Makiki, please enlighten me.
Kujou, please show me your skills.
The first round is Super Sweeper, nyaa!

In this event, both contestants have the same amount of time to clean an equally large area of the courtyard, and the contestant who manages to clean their area better wins! Now, let the contest begin, nyaa!
My friend, does Ichihime's introduction sound familiar to you too, woof?
Yes, maybe she has watched something strange recently.
While we chat, Riu Kujou and Mr. Makiki start cleaning quickly.
The competition between the two contestants is very fierce now, nyaa! The maid is sweeping up the fallen leaves at a terrifying speed, nyaa!
The teacher isn't to be outdone though. His graceful yet meticulous movements seem to be very rhythmic.
Master, it's time for you to make a comment, nyaa!
I think you're right.

However, you can still see the difference between them. Although Mr. Makiki is cleaning very seriously, Riu Kujou's cleaning is more skillful, methodical, and faster. I think the winner of this round is obvious.
Time's up!
The outcome is obvious. Although Mr. Makiki's area is very clean, there isn't a single fallen leaf in the area Riu Kujou cleaned. In addition... she has even given the bonsai a makeover.
Although I've only passed the junior horticulturist certificate examination, I'll continue to study and get better at it.
Horticulturist? Why haven't you mentioned that you're also studying something like that to me?
Gardening is an essential skill for a maid. I didn't have time to learn this while I was at school, but I haven't wasted a single day after graduating from high school.
Mr. Makiki looks deep in thought.
Okay, you win this round, but I won't give up so easily. I'm confident that I'll win the next round.
Let's move on to the second round now, nyaa!
According to my superficial understanding, a major part of a maid's job is to make tea for her master. Do you agree that it's fair for me to challenge you to a tea-making contest?
Of course. Please enlighten me.

After both contestants finish saying their simple and friendly pre-contest greetings, they both start preparing for this round. In this round, Ichihime, Wanjirou, and I will all taste the tea they make and choose the one we like more.
What a fragrant aroma! Look, Riu has added milk to the black tea she is making!
She's making milk tea? Well, the rules don't state that the contestants must make a traditional type of tea, woof. It looks like Miss Kujou has already won Ichihime's vote, woof.
Riu Kujou makes her signature Da Hong Pao milk tea and looks extremely confident. I turn to look at Mr. Makiki.

Burn incense to create a peaceful and solemn atmosphere... Scald the clean glass with boiling water to cleanse the tea cup and make it spotless... Pour boiling water into a pot and keep it there until the temperature drops to the optimal level...

Mr. Makiki burns incense, cleanses the tea, and accurately controls the water temperature while talking melodiously. Every step is in line with the tea ceremony etiquette, giving us a perfect tea ceremony performance.
The fragrant smell of tea wafts over and lingers in the air. Immersed in this atmosphere, I feel the urge to sit up straighter.
This is just too elegant, woof! My vote is definitely going to Mr. Makiki, woof.
Before long, Riu's Da Hong Pao milk tea and Mr. Makiki's Longjing tea are both served. Ichihime votes for her favorite milk tea, while Wanjirou votes for Mr. Makiki.
As they both have one vote, Riu Kujou and Mr. Makiki both look at me. Being the last to vote means that it's my responsibility to take the blame for offending others. I understand that...
Choose Riu Kujou's Da Hong Pao milk tea
Choose Mr. Makiki's Longjing tea
I'm sorry, Riu. I agree with what Wanjirou said, so I'm going to vote for Mr. Makiki.
Thank you.
Okay, so I lose this round.
It's a one-to-one tie now, nyaa! Let's move on to the final round! I'm going to the kitchen to get things ready, nyaa!
She's so proactive and shows so much initiative, woof.

The last round of the contest is a cooking competition, which is naturally what Ichihime is looking forward to the most. In fact, I'm also looking forward to it because I've had dinner at Chiori Mikami's house before, and I was lucky enough to taste Riu Kujou's cooking. If I were to comment on her cooking, I would say that she is a woman who can conquer Chiori Mikami's stomach.
But I swear that I didn't vote for Mr. Makiki just now because I wanted to drag out the contest until the last round!
Riu?

I scratch my head and want to explain why I voted for Mr. Makiki to Riu Kujou, only to find that she had made her way to him when I wasn't paying attention and is now sitting opposite him, looking thoughtfully at the tea set he just used.
So there's also so much to learn about making and drinking tea. I really do have a lot to learn.
If you're interested, would you like to learn the orthodox tea ceremony from me?
Based on what I know about you, the next thing you'll say is, "if you want to learn this from me, you'll need to go to college first." Am I right?
Haha, that really is what I had planned...
Oh no, nyaa--{var:Shake}
Ichihime suddenly runs back in a panic.
The expired ingredients that I told Master to throw away are still in the kitchen, but all the fresh ingredients are gone, nyaa!
...Wait a minute. Are you telling me that the garbage I worked really hard to throw away outside just now actually isn't rubbish?
I mixed them up, nyaa...
Oh well, the apologetic look in her eyes tells me that she must be feeling guilty about this. I should just forgive her.
Nyaa... This is such a rare opportunity to eat a meal cooked by Riu. This is terrible, nyaa!
!!! I knew it!!!
Let's all calm down. The scheduled third round can't proceed now. The first professional maid skills contest of Mahjong Soul Shrine is going to fall apart, woof.
It's alright. If we can't have a cooking contest, we can compete in something else, right?
Riu Kujou raises her finger indifferently.
Fashion design, nutrition, financial management, flower arrangement art, home first aid... Mr. Makiki, you can challenge me in any of these.
Hahaha, I don't think it's necessary.
Mr. Makiki smiles with relief when he sees Riu Kujou's confident expression.
I admit defeat.
I was so anxious before because I was worried that you would make a bad life decision due to a lack of proper consideration, but our interactions today have shown me that I've been too narrow-minded.

Although you won't be continuing your studies in college, you have a better idea of what you want to do with your life than your peers. Since you've managed to teach yourself so many skills, you've already shown that you're more motivated and self-disciplined than most people.
I'm sorry. I had some misunderstandings about your career. I won't interfere with your decisions anymore. Just do whatever you want.
Mr. Makiki...
Riu Kujou looks a little touched.
I won't let you down. Please drink some tea.
However, just as Riu Kujou is about to pour him some tea, Mr. Makiki suddenly stands up.
No, not that one.
Hmm?
Mr. Makiki stands and walks over to the milk tea Riu Kujou made.
Speaking of which, I don't think I've really tried drinking hot milk tea like this. I think the students of today quite like this. Can I try some too?
Of course you can. I'll pour you a cup now!
The two look at each other and smile. Everything they need to say to make up with each other is conveyed in this cup of tea.

After tasting the milk tea, Mr. Makiki says he has something else to do and says goodbye to us. After that, rain falls suddenly, sweeping away the mugginess of summer and doing our outdoor cleaning work for us, which means our cleaning session is now over.
This is great! To be honest, I'm already a little sleepy, woof. My friend, please make yourself at home here with Miss Kujou, woof.
Because we're bored, Riu Kujou and I polish the mahjong tiles in the reception room while we wait for the rain to stop so we can go back home.
Thanks for everything today.
Hmm?
Riu Kujou suddenly thanks me.
Stop pretending. It was your idea to have today's contest, right?
...Eh? How did you know?
Is it supposed to be hard to guess? You're the only one who would come up with a strange idea like that.
Haha, okay. You got me.
Riu Kujou has guessed right. When I met Mr. Makiki outside the shrine several hours ago, I already asked him why he had come and gave him some advice.
...So did Chiori tell you that Riu is here?
Several hours ago

Yes. I had some contact with the lady Kujou served during the three years that she was in high school. I know that they grew up together and that Kujou doesn't want to leave her, but Chiori Mikami hopes that Kujou can go to college and give herself more options in the future.
...But given Riu's personality, she wouldn't agree to leave Chiori even if Chiori encouraged her to do so herself.
That's right, but because I was her homeroom teacher, I want to try one more time.
Thank you for caring about her.
Do you think you can help me persuade her?
Mr. Makiki, I know that you have good intentions, but neither you, me, nor Chiori can make decisions for Riu in regard to what she wants to do or what kind of person she wants to be in the future.
So that's what you think... Sigh, am I the one who is wrong?

How about I set up a channel for you two to communicate and find a method that you can both accept to help you understand each other's thoughts better? Maybe you'll both learn something that you didn't know about each other. What do you think?
A different way of communicating... What do you have in mind?

That's what happened. See? I didn't actually do anything. The main reason is that you and Mr. Makiki had a misunderstanding. He wanted you to be the best version of yourself, and that's also what you want from yourself. You just have a different idea of how you'll achieve that.

Going to college isn't just about learning certain professional skills. It's also an environment and platform for young people who have just become adults to train themselves, broaden their horizons, and meet many good friends...
Okay, that's enough. Are you possessed by Mr. Makiki or something...? I know all that.

I don't actually hate college, but Miss Chiori is still in middle school, and this is a time when she really needs someone to be with her. Mr. and Mrs. Mikami are both busy with work and can't keep her company. If I'm also gone, how lonely would Miss Chiori be...?
When she says this, Riu Kujou looks a little downcast, which is uncharacteristic of her. Suddenly, I realize that this conundrum can only be resolved by the person at the center of it.
Riu, have you considered that Chiori will need to go to college one day?
...!!! {var:Shake}
Riu Kujou comes to a sudden realization.
You're right! As a professional maid, I will have failed my duties if I don't have a full understanding of that in advance!!!

So will you consider finding out what it's like for yourself first? Some of my good friends are at the National University of Fuuchi. Why don't we play mahjong with them one day so you can take the opportunity to ask them what it's like on the campus...? Hey, why are you looking at me like that?
{var:player_nickname}, I'm starting to understand why Miss Chiori treats you differently.
But what will happen to Miss Chiori? If I really go to college...
I'm still here, aren't I? I can play with her... Argh!
Before I can finish speaking, Riu Kujou's iron fist is flying right at me.
I cover my head in fear. Riu Kujou's fists crackle loudly while she clenches them, making it clear that her fighting spirit has been rekindled.
Haha, I almost fell for your trick! You said all that because you have designs on Miss Chiori!
No, I don't! Riu, let me explain!
Save your breath. Take this punch!
In any case, from that day on, Riu Kujou began to seriously consider the feasibility of going to college. This is a good start.

You've already done a great job, but it'll be a little difficult for the few of us to clean the entire Mahjong Soul Shrine. I'll arrange to do that on another day, so shall we concentrate on enjoying mahjong today?
Hmm... you're right. After all, my main objective is to complete the mission Miss Chiori gave me!
Robbing a Kan!
Noon
Pure Straight!
Full Flush!
Double Yakuman!
...Riu, you're not usually this fierce when you play mahjong, right?
The faces of the Jyanshi who move before and after her turn pale, and they quickly try to escape while I look at Riu Kujou in disbelief.
Oh, that's because Miss Chiori was present, so I needed to consider the mood of her opponents.
Thanks for the game. Let's call it a day.
What? You want to stop now after winning the entire morning?
I'm only here to play on behalf of Miss Chiori in the morning. Do you have a problem with that?
After that day, I had a new understanding of Riu Kujou's mahjong abilities.
I'm sorry, Mr. Makiki. I agree with Ichihime, so I'm going to vote for Riu.
Riu has won two rounds now, nyaa.
It's best out of three, so Miss Kujou is the winner, woof.
Sigh, okay then. I guess I really don't understand the preferences of you young people. You win, Kujou.
Unexpectedly, Riu Kujou doesn't look very happy after winning.
Although I won based on the number of votes I got, I didn't realize that there's still so much to learn about the art of making tea. Mr. Makiki, I've still got a lot to learn.
Haha, since you have this awareness, it means that I haven't come here in vain today. Well, I'm a man of my word, so I won't try to persuade you to go to college again since I lost.
But no matter what you do, I hope you can look further ahead and keep learning to keep improving.
Riu Kujou considers his words and nods seriously.
Thank you, I'll do that.
Mr. Makiki says he has other matters to attend to and needs to leave, so Riu Kujou and I accompany him all the way until we are outside the shrine.
On our way back inside after a brief goodbye, Riu Kujou makes a worried expression. She stops and looks back at Mr. Makiki's seemingly lonely back behind us.
{var:player_nickname}, do you think I've made Mr. Makiki sad?
At this moment, we hear Mr. Makiki stop and make a phone call.
Hello, it's me, Mr. Makiki... Hello? ...What!? Skipping classes and failing tests, and now you're hanging up on me! I'm going to teach you a good lesson!
Mr. Makiki, who seemed a little sad before, hangs up the phone and suddenly seems to be motivated again. He angrily scans a QR code to hire a rental bicycle and rushes off.
I pat Riu Kujou's shoulder.
What can I say? It looks like you're not the worst student out there.
I thought that Riu Kujou would punch me after I said this, but to my surprise, she pushes my hand away and continues walking inside.

Of course not. Although he doesn't understand my decision right now, I'm confident that I'll become a student he'll be proud of from the bottom of his heart in the future. Come on, cleaning the Mahjong Soul Shrine is just the beginning! Let's clean the outdoor areas in the afternoon!
What? More cleaning? Aren't you tired?
Haha, you're underestimating me. Follow me now!
Wait up...

On this day, under the leadership of the amazing Riu Kujou, the Mahjong Soul Shrine became incredibly clean and tidy thanks to our efforts. But at the same time, my arms got so sore that I couldn't play mahjong for an entire week... How terrible!
Our first contestant is Riu Kujou, the 19-year-old genius maid who is a rising star in the cleaning sector, woof.
Our other contestant is Mr. Makiki of St. Tina's Girls' School who has been a teacher for most of his life and doubles as a cleaning expert, woof...
Ichihime is already so tired that she has fallen asleep, and Wanjirou keeps yawning as he goes back inside.
